hierarchy.notes: Read-only daily operating picture over normalized local usage with trust permanently separated from usage and proof totals.

classification.notes: The default terminal and JSON paths are read-only. HTML writes require an explicit flag. Trust discovery is disclosed and cannot affect usage, spend, verification, or integrity totals.

ssa_v2.notes: Pure model, terminal renderer, static HTML renderer, command adapter, router seam, and focused tests have explicit responsibilities; every owned code file is below 400 lines.

ssi.notes: One MissionControl snapshot drives terminal, JSON, HTML, burn, proof, freshness, local AI, trust separation, and recovery actions.

sstf.notes: Six focused model, renderer, validation, empty-state, and real CLI routing tests pass inside a 538-test clean release gate with typecheck and build.

spe.notes: The brick adds no dependency, server, watcher, database access, provider usage request, or automatic publish path.

srs.notes: Estimates, source proof, verified share, freshness, NOT USAGE trust context, read-only usage, zero upload, and excluded sensitive fields are explicit.

ssra.notes: Built CLI ran against 48,023 real local records; Chromium mobile, desktop, and 4K layouts have zero horizontal overflow, clipped text, scripts, or external resources.

sas.notes: Owned, public, private, forbidden, and side-effect boundaries are explicit; the existing CLI router receives only a 21-line integration seam.

sva.notes: Reports exclude prompts, outputs, secrets, media, and credential values; HTML escapes record labels and has a deny-by-default CSP.

srls.notes: The brick does not access a database.

sev.notes: The brick requires no environment variables.

ssc.notes: The brick adds no package dependency and reuses core aggregate, record, trust, and integrity contracts.

sai.notes: Lease, intent, rationale, planned paths, real runtime proof, and responsive browser proof are recorded.

code_budget.notes: The model holds the domain contract while renderers and command parsing remain small; no existing large CLI surface was expanded beyond the router seam.

verification.command: focused Mission tests + typecheck + build + real built CLI + Chromium mobile/desktop/4K
verification.notes: Six focused tests pass; the built CLI renders 48,023 real records; 390x844, 1440x1200, and 3840x2160 static-file browser checks report no horizontal overflow, clipped text, scripts, or external resources.

verification.command: pnpm sma:release-gate + pnpm audit --audit-level high + SMA project rescan + Graphify module refresh/check/query
verification.notes: 15 controller tests and 538 package tests pass; strict telemetry, TypeScript, build, and dependency audit are clean; scanner reports zero Mission health warnings or metric drift; 17/17 module graphs are satisfied and CLI retrieval resolves all Mission symbols.

install_steps: Connect the command adapter to a normalized read-only ledger.
Keep trust context outside usage and proof totals.
Run focused, typecheck, build, real-ledger, and responsive browser verification.
known_traps: Operation quantities and record counts are different measures.
USD values are estimates and must never be labelled source truth.
Trust context must never affect usage, spend, verification, or integrity totals.
The default command must not write usage or upload data.

created_by.summary: Added a read-only CLI Mission Control over real normalized usage with terminal, JSON, and static HTML output.
created_by.intent: Turn the fully-live accepted roadmap into a useful daily operator surface without inventing synthetic usage or weakening trust separation.
created_by.decision_rationale: An isolated pure model and renderer brick adds a daily workflow while limiting the mature CLI router change to one bounded seam.
